caption:
How to plan a week of social media posts with AI in about 30 minutes

Most of the time doesn't go into posting. It goes into staring at a blank calendar, writing seven captions from scratch and remembering to take photos.

Copy this:

"You're my social media helper. Business: [WHAT YOU SELL + WHERE]. This week: [NEWS, OFFERS, EVENTS]. Plan 7 posts, Monday to Sunday. For each: day, post type (photo, tip, behind the scenes, offer), a caption under 40 words, and the photo I should take. Max 2 sales posts."

I tried it for an invented flower shop with three bits of news: new wreaths, a Saturday workshop, closed Sunday. Back came a full week, each post with a caption and a photo idea.

Then: shoot all the photos in one go and schedule the week.
